svg.aria-label: How postline works: Claude talks to your own Cloudflare Worker. A publish goes through tools.ts and linkedin.ts to LinkedIn's API; a saved draft goes through store.ts to Cloudflare KV; sign-in goes through linkedin-handler.ts. Claude never sees your LinkedIn token.

g.text: tools.ts asks linkedin.ts, the only file that talks to LinkedIn.
store.ts keeps drafts and post records, every key starting with your member ID.
linkedin-handler.ts runs the sign-in. Claude never sees your LinkedIn token.
